expected: After an ON edge raises the local failure issue naming ON, saving ON as replacement with [] (a mute) durably deletes the local_action_failed issue of the device; after re-raising it, saving ON as additive with [] deletes it too.
actual: The issue is still present right after the mute save (AssertionError 'a mute of the named trigger ends its local failure issue' at the first assertion after the mute): Manager.async_set_local_action saves the record but never clears the issue, so only a proven success or removal of the record ends it (WR-02).
semanticAssessment: Valid semantic RED. The target node was collected and executed (1 test, 0 errors, 0 skipped). Setup and the premise passed: the ON edge raised the issue naming ON. The test then failed on the planned assertion '_local_issue(...) is None' right after the mute save, because the current Manager does not clear the issue on a save without local actions (WR-02). Not an import, collection or fixture fault. The companion tests fail at their planned points too: the renamed survival test on the mute step (line 1002), and the T-11-49 test only on the final durable empty save (line 1104), after its other-trigger, non-empty-save and failed-save premises held.
